item.title: Federal civil rights data on students finally released, but harder to access under Trump
item.description: The Education Department's extensive civil rights data on public school students is now available, though less user-friendly than before.

item.title: Germany's far-right could win state election, a first since WWII
item.description: The AfD's rise in Saxony-Anhalt, fueled by TikTok, raises concerns about the country's first far-right governor since the war.

item.title: Which app saw a download surge after Trump's 'Lake America' change? The quiz has the answer
item.description: Also: George Santos makes a return to the headlines.

item.title: Scientists identify key protein interactions linked to profound autism
item.description: A study in Science reveals a missing piece in the biology of profound autism, offering new research targets.
